Wadarta saddex lambar oo dabiici ah oo isxiga waa $3S$, taranka kan ugu yar iyo kan ugu weyn oo lagu daray $1$ wuxuu le'eg yahay $T^2$. Marka $S = 15$, keebaa ugu weyn saddexdan?
20261121-math-g11-1.s.s1.prompt: [H2 Baaritaanka Xisaabta (Sare)] Dhibaatada baaritaanka adag iyadoo la adeegsanayo Xisaabta Fasalka 11aad. Wadarta saddex lambar oo dabiici ah oo isxiga waa $3S$, taranka kan ugu yar iyo kan ugu weyn oo lagu daray $1$ wuxuu le'eg yahay $T^2$. Marka $S = 15$, keebaa ugu weyn saddexdan?
20261121-math-g11-1.s.s1.explain:

Tallaabada 2: Saddexda lambar waa $14, 15, 16$.
Tallaabada 3: Lambarka ugu weyn waa $16$.
Tallaabada 4: Xaqiijin: $(14 \times 16) + 1 = 224 + 1 = 225 = 15^2$.

20261121-math-g12-1.s.s1.prompt: [H3 Baaritaanka Xisaabta (Sare)] Dhibaatada baaritaanka adag iyadoo la adeegsanayo Xisaabta Fasalka 12aad. Wadarta saddex lambar oo dabiici ah oo isxiga waa $3S$, taranka kan ugu yar iyo kan ugu weyn oo lagu daray $1$ wuxuu le'eg yahay $T^2$. Marka $S = 15$, keebaa ugu weyn saddexdan?
20261121-math-g12-1.s.s1.explain:
Tallaabada 1: Isagoo lambarrada loo qaadanayo $n-1, n, n+1$, wadartu waa $3n = 3S \Rightarrow n = S = 15$.
Tallaabada 2: Saddexda lambar waa $14, 15, 16$.
Tallaabada 3: Lambarka ugu weyn waa $16$.
Tallaabada 4: Xaqiijin: $(14 \times 16) + 1 = 224 + 1 = 225 = 15^2$.
20261121-math-g12-1.s.s1.hint.0: Qaadashada lambarro isxiga sida $n-1, n, n+1$ waxay bixinaysaa wadarta $3n$.

20261122-math-g12-1.title: Xisaabta Fasalka 12aad
20261122-math-g12-1.goal: Codso mabaadi'da Xisaabta Fasalka 12aad si aad u xalliso dhibaatada baaritaanka.
20261122-math-g12-1.material: [H3 Baaritaanka Xisaabta] Su'aasha baaritaanka ee ku saabsan Xisaabta Fasalka 12aad. Laba lambar oo dabiici ah $A$ iyo $B$ waxay buuxinayaan $A + 2B = 24$. Marka $A$ qaato qiimaha ugu sarreeya ee suurtogalka ah, waa imisa qiimaha $B$?
20261122-math-g12-1.s.s1.prompt: [H3 Baaritaanka Xisaabta] Su'aasha baaritaanka ee ku saabsan Xisaabta Fasalka 12aad. Laba lambar oo dabiici ah $A$ iyo $B$ waxay buuxinayaan $A + 2B = 24$. Marka $A$ qaato qiimaha ugu sarreeya ee suurtogalka ah, waa imisa qiimaha $B$?
20261122-math-g12-1.s.s1.explain:
Tallaabada 1: Dib u habaynta isla'egtu waxay bixinaysaa $A = 24 - 2B$.
Tallaabada 2: Maadaama $A, B \ge 1$ ay yihiin lambarro dabiici ah, $2B$ waa inuu noqdaa kan ugu yar si $A$ u weynaado.
Tallaabada 3: Lambarka dabiiciga ah ee ugu yar waa $B = 1$.
Tallaabada 4: Meeshan, $A = 24 - 2(1) = 22$ (ugu sarreeya), markaa $B = 1$.
20261122-math-g12-1.s.s1.hint.0: Qiimaha ugu yar ee lambarka dabiiciga ah ee $B$ waa $1$.
20261122-math-g12-1.s.s1.hint.1: Maadaama $A = 24 - 2B$, $A$ wuxuu noqonayaa mid weyn marka $B$ uu yar yahay.
